summary: Verified two fixes for Admin Finansal Rapor: (1) branch attribution via cashbox mapping and (2) per-branch monthly tables. Backend: 11/11 pytest pass, including new test_branch_attribution_via_cashbox that asserts Matematik vergi=500, total_expense>=6500, and Fen Bilimleri/Türkçe now have populated teacher_payment. Frontend: charts render for Genel + 3 branches; three separate MonthlyTable blocks render (fin-table-block-{Matematik|Fen Bilimleri|Türkçe}) each with 12 rows; single combined 'fin-monthly-table' is gone (count=0); toggling fin-toggle-vergi adds a 'Vergi' dashed line to the Matematik chart and Matematik table shows 500 vergi value; all 6 optional toggles (reklam, ofis, teacher_payment, vergi, sermaye, diger) add/remove their lines correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py effective_branch(p) fallback via cashbox_branch_map is the correct fix; ensure cashbox_branch_map is refreshed per request (cashboxes rarely change but mapping is fetched at report time).
AdminFinancialReport.jsx: table block key uses branch display name (with space) as data-testid suffix (e.g., fin-table-block-Fen Bilimleri). Works but consider slug/id-based test ids for robustness.
seed_data_creation: None. Read-only verification. test_transfers_excluded creates/cleans up its own data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Financial report backend and UI fully validated after iteration_24 fixes. Backend curl: branch_charts.Matematik totals -> vergi=500, expense=6500, reklam=5000, diger=1000; Fen Bilimleri teacher_payment=31400; Türkçe teacher_payment=2000. Frontend renders 4 charts + 3 per-branch tables (no combined table).
rca_of_the_issue: Prior: expenses/teacher payments carry cashbox_id (no branch_id), so branch charts filtered on branch_id only showed zeros for Matematik vergi & other branches' teacher_payment. Fix adds cashbox_branch_map and effective_branch(p) = p.branch_id or cashbox->branch, applied in both general and branch chart aggregation. Frontend now renders MonthlyTable once per branch instead of a single combined table.
